entities.summary: Matthijs Christian Brouwer is a field hockey player from the Netherlands, who won the silver medal with the Dutch national team at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens. The striker made his debut on 2 June 2000 in a friendly match against Spain. He played for HC Den Bosch in the Dutch League (Hoofdklasse), but moved to Oranje Zwart in the summer of 2005. His cousin Ronald also is a member of the Netherlands hockey squad. Matthijs Brouwer was a athletes & competitors from Raamsdonk (b. 1980-07-01, Raamsdonk). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
